title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - BookingChannel
description: A channel through which a tourism resource, service or organisation can be booked (estur:BookingChannel, a ContactPoint subclass, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'BookingChannel'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

url.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. One or more booking URLs; inherited from ContactPoint. Modeled as an array because the source ontology's own documentation example uses multiple values for the same channel (e.g. a direct booking URL and a central reservations URL).

onSite.description: Relationship. The Place where this booking channel operates on-site (estur:onSite).
